Chapter 152: 0149 I Have Many Plans (Bonus chapter for Alliance Leader BrL)

Next to Lin Dongliang was a woman named He Fang, not yet thirty years old, who was the investment manager he had brought with him.

In a situation like this, it meant either the woman was truly brilliant, or she had connections.

For example, her parents had vast resources, sent their daughter to a prestigious university abroad, got her an internship at an investment firm while she was still a student, and she returned to China to participate in investment projects immediately after graduation.

"This is Mr. Lin Dongliang, a partner at IDG China, and this is Ms. He Fang, an investment manager at IDG China."

Wang Kai made the introductions for both sides, "Mr. Lin, Ms. He, these two are the founders of ByteDance, Chen Guiliang and Guo Feng."

The four shook hands and greeted one another.

"Let's go inside for a tour first," Wang Kai suggested.

Chen Guiliang smiled slightly, "Please."

The employees had long since been informed and were all working diligently. Even those with nothing to do were busy pretending to be.

Chen Guiliang spent about ten minutes giving a general introduction to his company.

Strictly following the steps of a Series A investment, today was considered the preliminary contact. If IDG confirmed their intention to invest, the next step would be to sign a non-disclosure agreement, after which Chen Guiliang would provide them with detailed information and data.

Following that would be the initial due diligence, where IDG would send a team over to verify the company data provided by Chen Guiliang.

Then would come the formal negotiations between the two parties.

After that, detailed due diligence would ensue, a comprehensive check of legal, financial, and business risks.

The final steps would be the negotiation and closing of the investment agreement, signing the contract, and completing the capital injection.

But at this time, when investment partners were investing in projects in China, they often didn't adhere to these procedures, appearing rather casual.

For example, with MSN last time, they had stated the investment amount directly at Chen Guiliang's request.

"May I have a look next door?" Lin Dongliang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "Please."

After touring Game Science, the woman named He Fang couldn't help but ask, "Is Game Science already profitable?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Yes."

"What is the monthly profit from *Sanguosha*?" He Fang asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "I'll tell you after we sign a non-disclosure agreement."

He Fang asked again, "Why not merge the two companies?"

"Game Science specializes in games, and ByteDance handles other business," Chen Guiliang said.

He Fang asked, "Does this mean ByteDance won't be involved in the gaming business?"

Chen Guiliang replied, "Not necessarily. If ByteDance receives sufficient funding, I might also acquire a gaming company."

He Fang said no more.

Lin Dongliang said, "Let's find a room to talk."

Wang Kai quickly said, "There's a meeting room on the second floor."

Everyone then proceeded to the second floor.

Wang Kai asked about everyone's preferences and had someone bring coffee and hot tea.

Lin Dongliang asked, "Mr. Chen, what are your long-term plans for ByteDance and Xiaonei?"

Chen Guiliang said, "To build a campus social ecosystem centered around Xiaonei, which will be expanded beyond campuses in the future."

"But there are many similar websites. What's your differentiating barrier?" Lin Dongliang asked.

Chen Guiliang smiled, "Mr. Lin must be referring to the related services from MSN and QQ, right? The QQ Zone, which just started its beta, is a general social network, while Xiaonei is a real-name-based precision social network. As for similar competitors, I've encountered two. One is 5Q Campus Network, which has already been beaten into the ground. The other is Zhanzuo, which is making a lot of noise right now, but its user activity is very low."

He Fang interjected, "What about Sohu Alumni Record?"

"That's a product from the last era. I wouldn't deign to discuss it," Chen Guiliang said, then seemed to realize his slip of the tongue. "My apologies, I forgot that IDG is also a shareholder of Sohu."

Lin Dongliang asked, "What is your valuation of Xiaonei, CEO Chen? Just a rough idea, for my reference."

Chen Guiliang countered, "Last year, you invested in Fenbei, injecting 2 million USD at once. I don't know how much equity you received. According to standard investment plans, it should be around 20%. Surely Xiaonei's valuation isn't lower than Fenbei's?"

Lin Dongliang chuckled, "That's not necessarily true. Fenbei's profitability far exceeds that of Xiaonei."

"As far as I know, the profitability of legitimate music platforms has always been a concern," Chen Guiliang asked, "How does Fenbei make a profit? By infringing on copyrights? China is ultimately a society ruled by law. Although the relevant laws are not yet perfect, the loopholes will surely be closed within two years."

Lin Dongliang smiled, which could be taken as an acknowledgment of the point, and turned to communicate with Guo Feng, "Does this Mr. Guo have anything to say?"

Guo Feng said, "I'm in charge of the tech side."

"Any thoughts on the technology?" Lin Dongliang asked.

Guo Feng was not cooperative, "No comment."

They chatted a little longer, and the conversation came to an end.

Wang Kai saw them downstairs and recommended two other projects he had, suggesting that IDG might as well consider them seriously.

Lin Dongliang readily agreed, deliberately giving the impression that he hadn't come specifically for Chen Guiliang.

The preliminary contact before financing could sometimes be completed in just over ten minutes, or it could drag on for one or two weeks.

After a walk around the Peking University Science Park, Lin Dongliang declined Wang Kai's invitation to stay for a meal, "I have to go to Tsinghua this afternoon, I have several projects to see over there as well."

Wang Kai could only worry anxiously.

After all, Lin Dongliang had completed both his undergraduate and master's degrees at Tsinghua.

After leaving the Peking University Science Park, the two of them chose to walk.

As they walked, Lin Dongliang asked, "What do you think?"

He Fang said, "This person is developing ByteDance and Game Science separately. He keeps promoting ByteDance but barely mentions Game Science. It's obvious that because *Sanguosha* is profitable, he doesn't want to seek financing for it at the moment. I'm afraid that if any good gaming projects come up in the future, he'll have Game Science handle them. This means it will be difficult for ByteDance to make money from games, and without games, the only remaining method of monetization is wireless value-added services."

Lin Dongliang listened attentively until she finished, "I was asking what you think of these two people?"

He Fang recalled carefully and commented:

"Guo Feng is a typical tech person. He doesn't need to be considered too much."

"Chen Guiliang is extremely arrogant and confident, and his thinking is very agile. Before coming to Beijing, I gathered public information on this person. He is very, very good at creating hype!"

"The author of *Wolf Totem* had no conflict of interest with him. Just because he wanted to ride the coattails of *Wolf Totem*'s popularity, he relentlessly attacked both the book and the author. Now, more and more people are joining the criticism. *Wolf Totem*'s reputation has been ruined, its sales continue to decline, and many bookstores have removed it from their bestseller sections. His own book, *Those Things in the Ming Dynasty*, has seen a huge sales boost as a result."

"And then there's 5Q Campus Network. It never revealed its parent company's information. I don't know how he found out, but he seized on the black mark of them making rogue software and mobilized an online army to crush them within two days."

"Zhanzuo had only been online for three days when Chen Guiliang launched an event on Xiaonei, completely suppressing Zhanzuo's massive promotional campaign."

"This person's methods are ruthless, and he strikes with extreme precision and speed!"

Lin Dongliang chuckled, "So, he's worth our investment. Just like the founder of Fenbei, who is shameless enough in his business dealings. Shamelessness is also an exceptional strength."

IDG's investment in Fenbei was very successful. Even if it were to blow up and go out of business someday, it had, through deceitful means, acquired the copyrights to a slew of internet songs like *Mice Love Rice*.

With these copyright resources, some company would always be willing to acquire Fenbei. And as an investor, IDG would be prioritized over the founding shareholders for returns; they could make a profit even if the company was sold for cheap.

"So we're investing?" He Fang asked.

She was very young and had joined IDG less than six months ago. This trip was purely for her to gain experience.

Lin Dongliang said, "You handle the preliminary procedures. I'll take over when it reaches the negotiation stage."

"Thank you, Mr. Lin." He Fang knew Lin Dongliang was giving her an opportunity to train.
